decision.reason: The user asked to prepare a release carrying the Goose fixes merged since rc.44 (Goose hooks on Windows desktop with setup --fix-sh, Goose session matching and cmd cd /d, and check receipts that survive a shell change or a task-less run), so Goose works fully with the released version. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
